summary:
Mobile Performance Optimization Plan & Completed Enhancements:
- Clamped devicePixelRatio to 1.0 on mobile across all active canvas layers (eliminating 80%+ fill-rate overhead on Retina/OLED phone screens).
- Converted MoonlightPhase from continuous CPU/GPU canvas loop to 100% hardware-accelerated CSS volumetric beam with conic gradients.
- Replaced expensive continuous filter: blur() keyframe animations in index.css with GPU compositor opacity transitions.
- Optimized backdrop-filter blur from 14px down to 8px desktop / 4px mobile with hardware-accelerated transforms.
- Eliminated all canvas ctx.shadowBlur calls (which force synchronous 2D Gaussian raster blur on every frame) in FloatingHeartsOverlay, AudioVisualizer, and StarfieldCanvas, replacing with fast multi-pass vector arcs.
- Streamlined Fireflies.tsx: replaced per-frame radial gradient allocations with direct arc passes; reduced mobile count to 12-18.
- Streamlined FallingLeavesOverlay.tsx: removed redundant fireflies/dust duplication, capped petals to 9-10 on mobile.
- Streamlined WeatherOverlay.tsx: replaced multi-band gradient loops with GPU CSS atmospheric haze and lightweight motes.
- Prevented touchmove React state spam in RealGardenBackground.tsx during mobile finger drag/scroll.
